about.text: The national yoghurt of Bulgaria, made with the two bacteria Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus and Streptococcus thermophilus, which work together and do not ferment milk alone. The milk is warmed to 30 to 45 °C and held for about 4 to 12 hours, then cooled to stop the fermentation.
